description_target.target_text: edge markers (1s) extend their aligned 4x4 hollow frame in their direction (up/down/left/right) by repeated frame copies until grid edge

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; Hollow 4x4 frames sit on a blank field; blue(1) strips on the grid
 ;; edges are extension markers. Each marker points at the frame whose
 ;; span it overlaps: that frame repeats as a chain of 4x4 frames
 ;; marching to the marked edge (clipped at the border). Output the
 ;; frames plus their chains on a clean background.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define frames  ;; (color r1 c1 r2 c2) per hollow 4x4 (12 cells)
       (map (lambda (o) (list (obj-color o) (obj-r1 o) (obj-c1 o)
                              (obj-r2 o) (obj-c2 o)))
            (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-h o) 4) (= (obj-w o) 4)
                                     (= (obj-size o) 12)))
                    (objects-multicolor g 0))))
     (define markers  ;; (dir rmin rmax cmin cmax) per blue strip
       (map (lambda (o)
              (list (cond ((zero? (obj-r1 o)) 'up)
                          ((= (obj-r2 o) (- h 1)) 'down)
                          ((zero? (obj-c1 o)) 'left)
                          ((= (obj-c2 o) (- w 1)) 'right)
                          (else 'unknown))
                    (obj-r1 o) (obj-r2 o) (obj-c1 o) (obj-c2 o)))
            (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 1)) (objects g 0))))
     (define (draw-frame out color r1 c1 r2 c2)
       (for/fold ((acc out))
                 ((p (filter (lambda (rc) (or (= (first rc) r1)
                                              (= (first rc) r2)
                                              (= (second rc) c1)
                                              (= (second rc) c2)))
                             (positions-in-rect r1 c1 r2 c2))))
         (if (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w)
             (set-cell acc (first p) (second p) color)
             acc)))
     (define (overlap? lo1 hi1 lo2 hi2)
       (not (or (< hi2 lo1) (< hi1 lo2))))
     (define (frame-for m)
       (find (lambda (f)
               (cond ((member? (first m) (list 'up 'down))
                      (overlap? (fourth m) (fifth m)
                                (third f) (fifth f)))
                     ((member? (first m) (list 'left 'right))
                      (overlap? (second m) (third m)
                                (second f) (fourth f)))
                     (else #f)))
             frames))
     (define (extend out m)
       (let ((f (frame-for m)) (dir (first m)))
         (cond ((eq? dir 'up)
                (let loop ((r (second f)) (acc out))
                  (if (< (- r 1) 0)
                      acc
                      (loop (- r 4)
                            (draw-frame acc (first f) (- r 4) (third f)
                                        (- r 1) (fifth f))))))
               ((eq? dir 'down)
                (let loop ((r (fourth f)) (acc out))
                  (if (>= (+ r 1) h)
                      acc
                      (loop (+ r 4)
                            (draw-frame acc (first f) (+ r 1) (third f)
                                        (+ r 4) (fifth f))))))
               ((eq? dir 'left)
                (let loop ((c (third f)) (acc out))
                  (if (< (- c 1) 0)
                      acc
                      (loop (- c 4)
                            (draw-frame acc (first f) (second f) (- c 4)
                                        (fourth f) (- c 1))))))
               ((eq? dir 'right)
                (let loop ((c (fifth f)) (acc out))
                  (if (>= (+ c 1) w)
                      acc
                      (loop (+ c 4)
                            (draw-frame acc (first f) (second f) (+ c 1)
                                        (fourth f) (+ c 4))))))
               (else out))))
     (for/fold ((out (for/fold ((o (empty-grid h w 0)))
                               ((f frames))
                       (draw-frame o (first f) (second f) (third f)
                                   (fourth f) (fifth f)))))
               ((m markers))
       (extend out m)))))
